[b]Taking a Stand | The Argos Collective[/b]
[i]ERENE: 2000[/i]

[i]The Democratic Republic of New Westmore is reaching out to the [nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation] and [nation]Goleornacha[/nation] with the intent to form the Argos Collective, a regional defense alliance to maintain sovereignty and self-determination in the continent. The need for such an alliance has become more apparent with the arrival of foreign colonial elements in the region on the island of Henaiia, now called Virginia.

Westmore firmly believes that colonialism is a scourge upon Erene and a potentially direct threat to the integrity of our nations. We hope our neighbours share the same sentiment too.[/i]

[b]THE REMOVAL OF BLUE DOVE FORCES FROM GENDARMINIAN ALICIA AND CAPRICORN, LAVIA PREPAIRS FOR WAR[/b]

[i]Blue Dove forces are shipping out of Gendarminian lands, returning to the ULR with some even going to aid their enemies [nation]North Arenenge[/nation]. Lavian ships have began stalking ships going to and from the raj, with helicopters and tuboprops buzzing cargo ships confirmed to be under the Gendarme flag. Additionally, all assets held in the ULR owned by Gendarme have been frozen until notice, Lavian naval strike fighters have been seen patrolling around the clock, and troops are massing along with the callup of many soldiers in the national guard to obtain naval landing training.[/i]

[i]In a statement made today, Representative Minister Wallace H. Achebe said[/i] "We shall not stand for such an invasion so close to us, by a power so entangled in it's own greed for it to expend men and resources for simple colonial gain while already being in a war caused by such. Even if this country was started by colonial greed, that simply reinforces our need to stamp it our entirely. Unless the withdrawal of all Gendarminian claims know under the fraudulent title of "Virginia," we will be forced to enact a blockade of [b][i]ALL[/i][/b] shups under the flag of Gendarme traveling through the Argos straight or to the land of "Virginia." This blatant disregard for other nations is only similar to that of a bully on the playground, one this nation intends to fight."
[b][u]A REMNANT IS FALLING[/u][/b]
